args.message:
Upgrade fastjson from 2.8.0 to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337

fastjson 2.8.0 is affected by CVE-2026-31337 (unbounded recursion
when parsing deeply nested arrays). Upgrade to 2.9.4, the fixed
version in the 2.x line.

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades the pinned `fastjson` dependency from `2.8.0` to `2.9.4`.

## Security fix
`fastjson 2.8.0` is affected by **CVE-2026-31337** (high severity): unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays. The fixed versions are `2.9.4` (2.x line) and `3.1.0` (3.x line). This PR stays on the 2.x line and upgrades to **2.9.4**.

## Testing
CI run `ci-0001` on commit `c8b8ab7878` passed.
